findings_fixed_forward.finding: The documented site backup could not run on this appliance at all.
findings_fixed_forward.measured: PostgreSQL runs at 16.3 inside the stayconnect-pg container while the host client is 14.23, so pg_dump aborted with 'server version: 16.3; pg_dump version: 14.23'. The script also defaulted PGUSER to 'stayconnect_site', which is the DATABASE name and not a role that exists, and a least-privilege service role cannot dump the whole database ('permission denied for table schema_migrations').
findings_fixed_forward.fix: deploy/scripts/stayconnect-site-backup.sh now uses the client that ships with the server when the server is containerised, compares client and server major versions before writing anything, takes the role from the administrative DSN that already points at the site database, and refuses an empty dump. Installed on the appliance and used to take this milestone's backup.

findings_fixed_forward.finding: The DOWN migrations cannot be run by the schema owner.
findings_fixed_forward.measured: Each DOWN ends by DELETING its own row from public.schema_migrations, and iam_v2_owner holds only SELECT and INSERT there -- deliberately, so a migration can record itself but cannot erase the record. Running the DOWN chain under SET ROLE iam_v2_owner fails with 'permission denied for table schema_migrations'.
findings_fixed_forward.fix: Recorded in the rollback procedure: the DOWN chain runs with the administrative credential that holds DELETE, and object ownership is normalised afterwards because a DOWN that RECREATES a function would otherwise leave it owned by that credential. Verified: 0 non-iam_v2_owner objects remained.

findings_fixed_forward.finding: The catalog fingerprint cannot prove a rollback returned the same schema.
findings_fixed_forward.measured: Rolling the chain down and back up produced an identical schema with a different catalog fingerprint, because dropped columns keep their attribute slots and every later column renumbers. It matches on a disposable database only because there the dropped columns are the last ones added.
findings_fixed_forward.fix: iam_v2_scratch/schema_structure_fingerprint.sql omits ordinal_position and nothing else, and the DB gate now rolls the WHOLE Phase-4 chain down and back up and asserts structural equality. 269/269.
